thread:
raya.sales: ZephyrMed hit us with an RFI. Key asks: on-prem/HSM support, POC commercial, data ingress options, and a compact capability matrix. PDF attached: https://drive.company/zephyrmed_rfi_march.pdf. Who can take the tech + sec bullets?

files-bot: Uploaded file `zephyrmed_rfi_march.pdf` (1.7MB) to #sales thread.

gil.eng: I can do infra. Short answer: we offer hosted, dedicated, and private/on-prem installs. For ingestion we support presigned S3, cross-account role, or secure SFTP for air-gapped transfers (SOW). Recommend presigned S3 for fastest onboarding.

nora.sec: Security notes: For PHI we require a signed BAA/DPA prior to transfer. Hosted POCs support customer-managed KMS; HSM-backed keys are available only with Private/on-prem and require SOW/legal signoff. Audit logs retained 30 days; POC artifacts default 14 days. Presigned URLs must be read-only and rotated for multi-batch uploads.

sam.finance: Commercials: propose a one-time POC credit $9,000 (covers hosted work + first 500GB ingress/egress). Private/on-prem trial: short-term commitment $22k/month (30-day min). Egress overage $0.09/GB. Support beyond included hours billed at $225/hr.

raya.sales: Can someone draft 5 short pasteable lines for the RFI fields: ingestion, residency, KMS/HSM, retention, egress + attachments?

gil.eng: Paste-ready: 
- Ingestion: "Presigned S3 URLs (recommended, TTL 24h) or cross-account read-only IAM role; secure SFTP available for air-gapped transfers via SOW."
- Residency: "Hosted POC data stored in customer-selected region; Private/on-prem options available for strict residency needs."
- KMS/HSM: "Customer-managed KMS supported for hosted POCs; HSM/FIPS-140 integration available in Private/on-prem with SOW."

nora.sec: 
- Retention: "Default POC artifacts retained 14 days; audit logs retained 30 days (immutable). Shorter retention configurable for sensitive datasets; signed DPA required for PHI."

sam.finance: 
- Egress/attachments: "POC credit $9k covers first 500GB ingress/egress; additional egress $0.09/GB. Attachments: pricing sheet, standard BAA/DPA, POC SOW template, capability matrix (uploaded)."

files-bot: Uploaded file `zephyrmed_poc_pricing_v1.xlsx` (32KB) to #sales thread.

raya.sales: Nice. Gil can you add the tiny presign command for their engineers?

gil.eng: Sure: `aws s3 presign s3://zephyrmed-incoming/data.tar.gz --expires-in 86400`

nora.sec: Add security contact: nora.sec@redwood.ai for questionnaire clarifications. Also we should include: "We will not run PII/PHI inference on shared developer sandboxes; access restricted to the POC tenant."

sam.finance: Confirming numbers are final. I'll attach the pricing sheet and SOW.

raya.sales: Thanks team 44d Ill assemble and get the RFI back to Zephyr by EOD.
